description: Force of Will's alternative cost (pay 1 life, exile a blue card from hand) used to counter an opponent's spell already on the stack, including rejecting the alternative cost when the exiled card isn't blue.
artificial_state_elements: Opponent's spell (Demonic Tutor) is an arbitrary stand-in target - any spell on the stack would do; Demonic Tutor is in the subject deck's own list but here represents a generic opponent spell.
Lotus Petal in hand is a deliberate distractor to test the 'blue card' restriction on the alternative cost, not a claim about a representative hand.
No lands/mana modeled - Force of Will's alternative cost requires none.
material_characteristics: Force of Will's alternative-cost text ('pay 1 life and exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost')
Only a blue card may be exiled to pay the alternative cost - Lotus Petal (colorless) is not a legal choice
Force of Will can be cast at instant speed in response to a spell already on the stack and resolves as a counter (CR 608.2b)
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the countered spell - any spell on the stack works identically for this test
All board state beyond the two players' relevant hands/stack

legal_actions: Cast Force of Will by paying 1 life and exiling Mystic Remora (a blue card) from hand, targeting Demonic Tutor on the stack
illegal_actions_to_reject: Pay Force of Will's alternative cost by exiling Lotus Petal instead of a blue card - CR 118.9/the card's own text requires the exiled card be blue
Cast Force of Will for its printed mana cost {3}{U}{U} with no mana available and no assumption that the alternative cost is mandatory - it's optional, but here it's the only payable option
expected.outcome_if_resolved: Force of Will resolves and counters Demonic Tutor (goes to seat 2's graveyard); Mystic Remora is exiled; seat 1's life total goes from 20 to 19.

rules_citations: CR 601.2b (alternative/additional costs paid as part of casting)
CR 608.2b (a spell/ability with an illegal or no-longer-valid outcome is countered by the game rules; here Force of Will's own counter effect sends Demonic Tutor to the graveyard on resolution)
